Maya (CS): Quick weekly signal for Gamma account — token + throughput snapshot. TL;DR: tokens +20% WoW, +8% QoQ; p95 latency 210ms (was 160ms last week); error rate bumped to 0.8% after yesterday's canary; spend pacing ~12% above commit. Sharing notes + ask for mitigations.

Liam (AE): Thanks Maya. Do we know if the token uptick is new users or increased per-session usage? Renewal call next Thursday — want to understand spend pressure.

Maya (CS): Mostly larger sessions from their search feature after they turned on streaming; number of sessions up ~5% but avg tokens/session +14%. I flagged streaming switch in onboarding notes.

Raj (CSE): Can try two quick knobs: 1) suggest prefix caching for repeated system prompts, 2) enable batch windows for search indexer jobs (they run many small calls). I can drop a patch for batching config.

Liam (AE): If we can show expected spend delta with batching, that will help renewal convo. Can you estimate savings, Raj?

Raj (CSE): Rough calc: batching + cache -> ~30-40% token reduction for search workload based on our test harness. Ballpark weekly savings $3k-$4.5k. Will validate with a short A/B.

Maya (CS): Noted. I'll book an enablement 30m with Gamma PM + engineers to go over caching patterns and streaming best practices. Proposed times: Wed 10am or Thu 2pm.

Liam (AE): Wed 10 works for renewal prep. Also asking finance to model commit uplift options if spend remains high.

ops-bot: Alert: canary deployment 2026-03-15 22:17 triggered minor error spike on model endpoint redwood-gamma-v2 (0.8% 5xx) — auto-rollback not triggered. Root cause flagged as tokenization edge-case on short bursts.

Maya (CS): I'll include that in the enablement agenda — show how short-burst tokenization can create repeated retries.

Raj (CSE): Will push a tokenization fix to canary and enable a temporary server-side retry cap to avoid amplified traffic.

Maya (CS): Action items: 1) Raj to validate batching + caching A/B and send savings estimate (ETA: Tue EOD). 2) Raj to patch tokenization canary + retry cap (ETA: Mon AM). 3) Maya to run enablement Wed 10 and prep spend delta slide for renewal. 4) Liam to prep commit options with finance (ETA: Thu EOD).

Liam (AE): Agree. Marking this as medium renewal risk until we show mitigation + savings.

Maya (CS): I'll update the health dashboard and ping if anything changes. Thanks team :thumbsup:
